get.description: Returns all of the Resource Planning Assignment data for the given company

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier for the company. This parameter accepts both formats:
- **Recommended**: Procore company ID (integer) - Use this for new integrations
- Legacy: LaborChart UUID format (uuid string) - Supported for backward compatibility

A proxy layer automatically handles both formats, but using the Procore company ID is preferred for consistency with other Procore APIs.

parameters.name: created_after
parameters.description: Filters items created on or after the specified date (inclusive). Accepts an ISO 8601 date string.

parameters.name: created_at
parameters.description: Filters items based on their creation timestamp. Accepts an ISO 8601 date string.

parameters.name: created_before
parameters.description: Filters items created on or before the specified date (inclusive). Accepts an ISO 8601 date string.

parameters.name: dayRange
parameters.description:
A value specifying how many days forward you would like to get assignments for from the specified startDay. Assignments whose start_day falls within the given range will be returned in the response.
The startDay parameter in conjunction with the dayRange parameter will create a range of dates that will filter each assignment based on its start_day field.
For example, passing in a startDay of 2024-01-01 and a dayRange of 1 will return all assignments that begin on either the 1st or 2nd of January.
If we pass in the same startDay, but with a dayRange of 15, the results will include all assignments whose start_day exists between the dates of 2024-01-01 and 2024-01-15.
Max value is 365.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description:
This is a **0-based index** representing the page slice of the data you want to retrieve. Each page contains up to **400 items**.
### **📌 Pageable Endpoints** People endpoints that return multiple records **support pagination**. It is recommended to use this feature to prevent network timeouts from excessively large data requests.
### **📌 Response Structure** A successful response will include the following properties:
- **`possible_pages`** *(integer)* → Total number of pages available to retrieve all data. - **`current_page`** *(integer)* → The **0-based index** of the page retrieved. - **`data`** *(array)* → List of records returned for the requested page (up to 400 items per page).
If a **page value exceeds** `possible_pages`, the `data` property will return an **empty array**.

parameters.name: start_day
parameters.description: The starting day to filter assignments by.

parameters.name: updated_after
parameters.description: Filters items updated on or after the specified date (inclusive). Accepts an ISO 8601 date string.

parameters.name: updated_at
parameters.description: Filters items based on their last updated timestamp. Accepts an ISO 8601 date string.

parameters.name: updated_before
parameters.description: Filters items updated on or before the specified date (inclusive). Accepts an ISO 8601 date string.

possible_pages.description: Total number of pages available based on the query parameters

current_page.description: The current 0-based page index of the returned data

data.description: List of people and their assignments

employee_number.description: Employee number assigned to the person

job_title_name.description: The job title associated with the person

job_title_id.description: Unique identifier for the job title

job_title_color.description: The color associated with the job title

assignments.description: List of assignments associated with the person

id.description: Unique identifier for the assignment status

start_day.description: Start date of the assignment (string format)

end_day.description: End date of the assignment (string format)

project_name.description: Name of the project assigned to

category_name.description: Name of the assignment category (if applicable)

category_id.description: Unique identifier for the assignment category (if applicable)

subcategory_name.description: Name of the assignment subcategory (if applicable)

subcategory_id.description: Unique identifier for the assignment subcategory (if applicable)

work_days.description: Workdays for the assignment, where 0 represents Sunday and 6 represents Saturday

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the assignment was created (string format)

updated_at.description: Timestamp of when the assignment was last updated (string format)

timeoff.description: List of time-off records for the person

is_paid.description: Indicates whether the time off is paid

repeat.description: Recurrence pattern of the time off

start_time.description: Start time of the time-off period

end_time.description: End time of the time-off period

start_day.description: Start date of the time-off period (string format)

end_day.description: End date of the time-off period (string format)

error.description: If you receive a 401 error, please ensure you are following the OAuth 2.0 guidelines outlined at https://developers.procore.com/documentation/introduction and verify you can successfully call the /me endpoint using your access token. Additionally, the user associated with that token must be added as a user in the Workforce Planning People List for the corresponding company.
